name: Rohit Martin Menghani
title: Masters Student
bio: Rohit Menghani is an Aerospace Engineer currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Computer Engineering with a specialization in Machine Learning and AI. His research interest is in the field of autonomous UAV operations and swarm activities. At the ASSIST Lab, he is involved in simulating UAVs in Gazebo using ROS. He is also a GSA for Florida Tech's Center for Advanced Manufacturing and Innovative Design (CAMID). In his free time, he loves playing tennis and football.
